title: graphql-dos-shield
offersHint: Cloudflare Workers MCP server: graphql-dos-shield · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://api.lazy-mac.com/graphql-dos-shield/mcp

toolsPreview.name: complexity_meter
toolsPreview.description: Analyze GraphQL query complexity. Returns depth, field count, list multipliers, and a risk level (LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH/CRITICAL). CRITICAL means the query should be rejected.

toolsPreview.name: rate_limiter
toolsPreview.description: Check and enforce rate limiting for a client. In-memory sliding window — state resets on cold start.

toolsPreview.name: query_rewriter
toolsPreview.description: Text-level rewrite of an overly complex GraphQL query: strips excess nesting depth and truncates too many fields.
